What "rule of thumb" is given to prevent the control system from

      exciting unmodeled structural resonances?
originalSourceText:
Q.4  What "rule of thumb" is given to prevent the control system from

      exciting unmodeled structural resonances?

     A) 𝜔𝑛 ≥ 2𝜔𝑟𝑒𝑠
     B) 𝜔𝑟𝑒𝑠 ≥ 2𝜔𝑛
     C) 𝜔𝑛 = 2𝜔𝑟𝑒𝑠
     D) 𝜔𝑟𝑒𝑠 ≠ 2𝜔𝑛
     Answer: B

     Refer to Lecture 22: Modeling and Control of a Single Joint Slide 11
